frontend/ui/mountShell.jsx.purpose: Django/browser integration for the shared shell top bar and mobile navigation: resolve theme tokens, bridge the existing sidebar open state, lift the HTMX-boosted search island into the shared bar, keep public sign-in link semantics and render the overlay while the server fallback remains.

frontend/errors/mountErrorRecovery.jsx.purpose: Mount the shared error recovery presentation over the server-rendered 400/403/CSRF/404/500 fallback: resolve theme tokens, copy the safe diagnostic report through the browser clipboard adapter, and keep report-issue, retry, login and home navigation as browser intents.

frontend/ui/mountCopyField.jsx.purpose: Mount the shared copy field over the server-rendered provider URL fallback: resolve theme tokens and copy through the browser clipboard adapter while the server input and copy control remain the no-JavaScript fallback.

frontend/ui/mountCacheStatus.jsx.purpose: Mount the shared static-cache card over the About page fallback: read the browser service-worker registration, controller, scope and floppy cache names through the platform adapter and refresh on request.

frontend/ui/mountDeviceConnect.jsx.purpose: Django/browser integration for the shared device-code card: poll the existing Trakt endpoint, follow its HTMX redirect, copy the code and open the activation page.

frontend/ui/mountStremioConfig.jsx.purpose: Standalone Stremio configure-page adapter: resolve the install base URL, copy the generated configuration and hand the install URL to the Stremio deep link.

frontend/ui/mountMetadataReview.jsx.purpose: Browser adapter for the shared episode-order chooser/review, TV provider-move confirmation and remap/library-move result choices: post the existing Django actions with CSRF, keep HTMX result replacement for library moves, navigate existing item and detail URLs, and retain the server-rendered fallback.

frontend/ui/mountBulkEpisodeForm.jsx.purpose: Browser adapter for the shared bulk episode/track range form: read the server serialized form model, hide the legacy form only when htmx is available, mirror the season/episode selection and date shortcuts, and post the same fields through htmx so Django validation, queued saves, close/toast triggers, CSRF and permissions stay server-owned.

frontend/ui/ProgressDetailTheme.web.jsx.purpose: Resolve document theme and mount the shared progress card and dialog over the existing htmx breakdown endpoint, cancel write, out-of-band card refresh and rewatch events while the Alpine card and modal stay as the server fallback.

frontend/ui/mountProgressDetail.jsx.purpose: Mount the shared progress card and dialog into the detail card slot.

frontend/ui/DetailChildrenTheme.web.jsx.purpose: Resolve browser theme tokens and route shared child-row opens, track/lists/history intents and episode/issue score writes to the existing navigation, hidden server controls and score endpoint; the server rows remain the fallback and source of permissions.

frontend/ui/mountDetailChildren.jsx.purpose: Django/browser integration that mounts the shared comic-issue rows inside the secondary-content host and hides the server row fallback while mounted.
